changes.description: Fixed test errors related to Parts API
changes.details: Modified the LDrawLoaderModule and PartsFileManager to properly detect and handle test environment, resolving unhandled rejection errors during tests.

changes.description: Moved key files to improve project structure
changes.details: Moved ldraw directory from public folder to project root, and moved ChangeLog.json from src folder to project root for better organization.

changes.description: Implemented Parts API for production optimization
changes.details: Created a Parts API to serve LDraw parts on-demand, reducing production build size by 478MB. Added middleware for development, documentation for production deployment options, and configured the build process to exclude the ldraw directory.

changes.description: Simplified editor synchronization
changes.details: Removed liveSync toggle and 'Update Viewer' button in favor of always keeping the editor and 3D view synchronized for a more intuitive user experience.

changes.description: Improved save functionality in SceneFileManager
changes.details: Added higher-level saveCurrentFile and saveAsNewFile methods to SceneFileManager to handle the full save workflow with proper error handling and user interactions.

changes.description: Added tests for SceneFileManager
changes.details: Created comprehensive test suite for the new SceneFileManager utility to ensure path normalization, file loading/saving, and error handling work correctly.

changes.description: Improved file management system
changes.details: Created a separate SceneFileManager utility to handle file operations, improved path normalization, and fixed issues with file selection.

changes.description: Fixed file selection dropdown showing duplicate entries
changes.details: Normalized paths and removed duplicates to prevent showing both default.ldr and scenes/default.ldr in the selection dropdown.

changes.description: Improved default file loading
changes.details: Removed hardcoded default content and replaced with loading from scenes/default.ldr with proper fallback handling.

changes.description: Fixed linter error in toggleLiveSync function
changes.details: Added proper error handling to fix 'error is defined but never used' linter warning.

changes.description: Upgraded Zustand from 3.7.2 to 4.4.1
changes.details: Fixed ESM/CJS module format conflicts by upgrading Zustand to 4.4.1. Updated import patterns to use named exports, improved Vite configuration for better ESM compatibility, and ensured React 17 compatibility.

changes.description: Fixed type safety issue in Canvas3D component
changes.details: Replaced 'any' type with proper LDrawPiece interface import in the model update logic to improve type safety and prevent potential runtime errors.

changes.description: Moved rotation matrix multiplication function to LDrawTransforms module
changes.details: Extracted multiplyRotationMatrices function from Canvas3D.tsx to LDrawTransforms.ts for better code organization and reusability. This makes the matrix operations available to other components and reduces duplication.

changes.description: Created TransformControlsManager class
changes.details: Created a dedicated TransformControlsManager class to handle 3D transform controls logic, event handling, and rotation operations. This improves code organization by separating transform controls logic from the Canvas3D component.

changes.description: Updated Canvas3D to use the TransformControlsManager
changes.details: Refactored Canvas3D.tsx to use the new TransformControlsManager class, removing direct TransformControls handling. This improves code organization and separates concerns, making the component more maintainable.

changes.description: Fixed TypeScript event type compatibility
changes.details: Created a type declaration file to properly extend THREE.EventDispatcher for TransformControlsManager events. This resolves TypeScript errors in the event handlers while maintaining type safety.

changes.description: Created SelectionManagerEventHandler class
changes.details: Created a dedicated SelectionManagerEventHandler class to centralize selection-related event handling, with comprehensive test coverage. This separates event management from the UI component, improving code organization and maintainability.

changes.description: Fixed Canvas3D component element selection
changes.details: Fixed the 3D viewer by reverting to using a React ref instead of getElementById for canvas selection. This resolves the 'Canvas element with ID undefined not found' error and restores the 3D viewer functionality.

changes.description: Created InputEventHandler to manage input events
changes.details: Created a dedicated InputEventHandler class to manage keyboard, mouse, and window events for the Canvas3D component. Extracted and centralized event handling code, reducing component complexity and improving maintainability. The InputEventHandler properly handles UI interactions, 3D object selection, and transform mode changes.

changes.description: Fixed selected objects disappearing when transform controls are attached
changes.details: Modified the TransformControlsManager.attach method to properly maintain object visibility and prevent loader reinitialization when selecting a piece. This fixes the issue where selected pieces would become invisible and trigger unnecessary PartGeometryLoader reinitialization.

changes.description: Fixed transform controls not detaching when editing in editor
changes.details: Fixed an issue where transform controls would not properly detach when editing pieces in the editor, causing console errors and incorrect behavior. Improved editor-viewer synchronization to ensure controls are properly detached during edits and to update the editor immediately after changes are processed in the 3D view.
